title: Kiritani Haruka — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: One week before Haruka's birthday
Stage SEKAI - Flower Field

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Everyone! I brought Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, Haruka! You can open your eyes now!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay, here I go.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's a little bit early, but...

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow. You set up a birthday party in the flower field, and even prepared flower petal showers.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It was Miku and the others that suggested celebrating in the field, and doing a flower shower.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They also did most of these decorations, too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
Then, those blue balloons...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah♪
We blew up a bunch to decorate with!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And of course you need flowers on your birthday.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We actually prepared more flowers for you than just the ones we used for the flower showers.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Here, I'll go first!
Happy birthday, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you, Len.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, it's a bouquet of paper flowers.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. They're meant to be chamomile flowers.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: All the flowers are so well made!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. The first time he showed me, I thought they were real for a second.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we're just getting started.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'll go next.
Happy birthday, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow... This flower is also made out of paper? It's so big!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I spent a lot of time picking the materials, so I only made one... But this can also be used as an aroma diffuser.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow, really?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's big and eye-catching. It'd be a nice addition to any desk or table. Thank you, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haruka! Next is from me and MEIKO♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Ta-da♪
It's a flower mobile and flower garland!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow! And these are all paper flowers too?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! The flowers and petals on the mobile are cherry blossoms.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The way they sway makes it look like the petals are dancing in the air, doesn't it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's such a wonderful idea.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can't wait to put this up in my room and see all the flowers swirl in the breeze.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, so if Rin made the mobile, does that mean you made this garland, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's right! I made it in pastel colors to suit any decor.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The flowers' colors are subdued, but there are a lot of them, so they should brighten up any room.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It would.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It might also look cute on one of my big penguin plushies...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
There are still more presents to go.
Right, Miku♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Here, Haruka! We made you a flower wreath, and a heart-shaped curio too♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow...! They're both so lavishly decorated!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I made the wreath. I got so into it while making it that I ended up making a lot more flowers than I planned♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too! I really wanted it to be a pretty heart shape, but somehow it just kept getting bigger.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I kept going “I'll put this here...oh, the silhouette is wrong now, so I'll fix this side too”♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Haha. Still, it ended up with a really nice heart shape all the same.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah... The shape turned out so beautiful. And each individual flower is so cute.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: All these presents are so wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you so much, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
You're welcome♪
You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can't wait to put them all up in my room.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That would make us very happy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you all for helping us buy all the materials, Minori, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. You're super welcome!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I still remember when we went to buy the materials.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After our meetings ended, we pretended to be going home, and met back up at the shopping mall!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That was so exciting! It really felt like we were preparing a surprise!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You did that? When was this? I didn't notice at all.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Which means, our surprise was a success!

rows.Speaker: Airi, Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm repeating myself, but thank you so much for these presents, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll put them all in my room and take good care of them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, everyone! There's still lots of party left to enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We have low-sugar cake and plenty of snacks you can enjoy, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's all eat them together!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes!
